name: jwt-version-gate
given: jwt.verify() without an explicit algorithms option on jsonwebtoken pinned to 9.0.2, next to a jwt.decode() whose claims decide a role
rationale: Same pattern, opposite verdicts, and only the lockfile separates them. 9.x removed the implicit none fallback, so the missing algorithms option on currentUser() is NOT a bypass here — that is the false positive a pattern-matcher makes, and should_not_find keys on the safe function's own name in the finding's identity. decode()-without-verify feeding an authz decision is a finding at every version. must_not_contain lists only other ecosystems' JWT libraries: the CVE id itself is legitimately citable, because the version rule requires naming the cutoff that was compared against.
